narrative.overview: Signal 90 is the board a deputy checks between shifts and a coordinator keeps on a second monitor: a calm, daylight surface of white cards on a cool gray canvas, one confident blue for everything you can act on, and status color only where a rule or a deadline needs attention. Night mode is the same board in low light.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white cards with a 1 px line, no shadows except the floating tab bar.
One accent blue for buttons, the active tab, links and filled staffing squares.
Status in soft pills and tinted cards: green open, amber warning, red danger, orange attention, blue info, purple coordinator.
Inter throughout, 400 to 700, a tight product scale from 11 to 28 px.
Line icons on a 24 px grid with a 1.8 stroke.
Day and night themes from the same tokens; the device decides until the person chooses.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you can act on this" or "you are here". Never use it for decoration, headings or icons at rest.

rules.name: The Status Means Something Rule
rules.body: A status color always names a state in words beside it. Color never carries a meaning alone.

rules.name: The No Hex Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic utilities. Tailwind's own palette is switched off; a hex value in a component is a bug.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Only the eleven sizes exist. No fluid type.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Money, hours and counts use tabular figures so columns line up.

rules.name: The Only Float Rule
rules.body: Only chrome that floats above scrolling content casts a shadow.

dos: Do use the semantic utilities from src/ui/tokens.css and the components in src/ui/components/.
Do show pay only through PayLabel.
Do keep one primary button per card on phones, 50 px tall and full width when it is the screen's main action.
Do pair every status color with words.
Do check every screen at 390 by 844 and 1280 by 900 in day and night, with an axe pass and no serious violations.
donts: Don't hard-code a hex value or use a Tailwind palette color in a component.
Don't add shadows to cards, tiles or buttons.
Don't add a second accent color or use blue for decoration.
Don't use a colored left or right border stripe on cards or alerts.
Don't use a modal where an inline section or a page works.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
